problem_statement: Requests issue #2316: In requests/sessions.py, method = builtin_str(method) converts a method such as b'GET' into the literal string "b'GET'" on Python 3, resulting in an invalid HTTP method. A caller such as python-neutronclient passes byte-valued methods. Fix Requests so byte-valued HTTP methods work correctly while preserving normal string method behavior. Work in the current checkout. You may run the protected offline reproduction with: python /opt/refit/integrations/mini_swe/verify.py . training. Submit the code change using the original mini-SWE-agent completion command. Do not change the protected evaluator or unrelated behavior.
